bundle.copyright: GPL-2.0-or-later. Contains ports of XFOIL (Mark Drela, Harold Youngren).
bundle.shortDescription: Airfoil analysis and optimization (XFOIL rewritten in Rust)
bundle.longDescription: Aero analyses 2D airfoils with the methods of XFOIL 6.996 (panel method and viscous boundary layer), compares many airfoils at once and optimizes their shape.
